# Quantum-L9 Python Repository

> Baseline repository chassis for Quantum-L9 projects that are not Constellation
> nodes or `constellation_*` dependency packages.

## Authority

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): cross-agent repository operating law
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Claude-specific overlay; never replaces AGENTS.md
- [.l9/architecture.yaml](.l9/architecture.yaml): authoritative product boundary
- [.l9/ownership.yaml](.l9/ownership.yaml): ownership and sibling boundaries
- [.l9/org-birth-profile.yaml](.l9/org-birth-profile.yaml): organization capability class
- [.l9/repo-workflow.json](.l9/repo-workflow.json): repository execution contract
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): architecture narrative

## Bootstrap and validation

```bash
./bootstrap.sh
make verify
make pr-check
pre-commit run --all-files
```

## Security and review surfaces

- [.pre-commit-config.yaml](.pre-commit-config.yaml): local mechanical checks
- [.semgrep/semgrep-rules.yaml](.semgrep/semgrep-rules.yaml): high-signal repo-local Semgrep rules
- [.gitleaks.toml](.gitleaks.toml): thin extension of the Gitleaks default rule set
- [.coderabbit.yaml](.coderabbit.yaml): L9-aware PR review instructions

CI execution and organization targeting remain centrally owned. Do not add a
repository-local workflow caller to compensate for a central CI gap.

## Birth and product boundaries

- [docs/ops/REPO_BIRTH.md](docs/ops/REPO_BIRTH.md): one-command birth contract
- [scripts/birth-runner/payload-ownership.yaml](scripts/birth-runner/payload-ownership.yaml): authoritative-vs-additive payload ownership

Use `Quantum-L9/L9-Node-Template` for Constellation nodes and
`Quantum-L9/Constellation.PackageTemplate` for `constellation_*` dependency
packages. Do not vendor or fork centrally owned CI or governance implementation.
